task: GitHub issue #46: benchmark harness extensibility — case registry, JSON export, usage metrics

acceptance.criterion: (1) Custom case list runs and reports without editing benchmarks.py internals
acceptance.evidence: test_custom_case_runs_via_explicit_list_without_editing_internals: constructs a BenchmarkCase with a custom program source and runs it through run_benchmark without modifying benchmarks.py; test passes (29/29 in test_benchmarks.py). CaseRegistry class with register/build/build_all/names enables registry extension; register_case() and builtin_registry_names() module-level functions expose the registry API.

acceptance.criterion: (2) to_json() roundtrips through json.loads with numbers identical to to_markdown's tables
acceptance.evidence: test_to_json_roundtrips_with_numbers_matching_markdown: json.loads(report.to_json()) produces a dict with speedup (round 2dp), wall times (round 1dp via _round1 matching _ms), dispatches, envelope bytes, delta, child_runs, child_events, tasks_per_child, authored_plans, authored_steps — all matching the markdown rendering; test_to_json_is_valid_json_and_deterministic: to_json() is valid JSON and two calls produce identical strings.

acceptance.criterion: (3) A usage-reporting worker factory shows non-zero usage in both outputs
acceptance.evidence: test_usage_reporting_worker_factory_shows_nonzero_usage: a worker factory whose handlers return {"usage": {"prompt_tokens": 10, "completion_tokens": 5, "total_tokens": 15, "cost_usd": 0.001}} produces a report with non-None usage on both sides; json.loads(report.to_json()) shows non-zero total_tokens in the usage block; UsageStats.from_result extracts from RESULT_RECEIVED result payloads.

test_existing_three_cases_unchanged: linear dispatches=6 envelope=5406, scatter dispatches=10 envelope=8993, PAR dispatches=9 envelope=8293 child_runs=5 authored_plans=1 authored_steps=3 — identical to benchmarks/report-2026-09-12.md. builtin_cases() returns the same three cases via the default registry. Full suite 770 passed (760 baseline unmodified + 10 new).

acceptance.criterion: Sealed program created before any source edit (Tikhon protocol steps 1-2)
acceptance.evidence: demo/runs/sprint1-46-bench-registry/program.think linted valid and sealed to 861a39c3a... before the first source edit; seal re-verification after all edits produces the identical digest.

acceptance.criterion: Full pytest suite green; only OWNED files touched
acceptance.evidence: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -> 770 passed in 21.41s; git status --porcelain shows M src/tikhon/benchmarks.py, M tests/test_benchmarks.py, ?? demo/runs/sprint1-46-bench-registry/ only.

unresolved: The to_markdown output does not add a usage table — usage is visible in to_json and CaseResult.usage_delta_tokens; the markdown report's Honest caveats already state usage is recorded as unknown in the deterministic path. A live-model run would show usage in JSON.
protocol_deviations: test_register_case_adds_to_default_registry uses a private CaseRegistry to avoid polluting the shared module-level default registry (the registry has no unregister method; a shared-registry test would break other tests that rely on the default's three-case count)
